bounds.basis: Highest Standard long-context cache-write/output rates plus 10% regional margin. The input envelope is eight times the prompt tokens measured across 288 earlier receipts for the same image inputs; a receipt above it is uncertain and stops the run.

budget_note: This run's own cap. Sequential durable reservations; confirmed usage releases conservative headroom. Stop on an uncertain receipt or insufficient remaining headroom; never retry.
